kids: Watch lit floats roll through downtown
Hear marching bands and holiday carolers
See Santa at the grand finale
about: Downtown Boulder Community Initiatives presents the Lights of December Parade.
The 2026 parade is Saturday, December 12, starting at 6 PM.
Floats are created and decorated by local businesses, churches, schools, community groups and nonprofits.
The host lists marching bands, lit fire engines and holiday carolers.
The grand finale is an appearance by Santa Claus.
The route starts at 15th and Walnut streets and heads west to Broadway.
It continues north on Broadway, turns east on Spruce and finishes at 15th and Spruce.
The reviewing stand, with announcements about each group, is at Broadway and Pearl.
Spectators are asked to stay behind the fencing and out of the streets.
Parade entries were capped at 50 and the host reports all spaces are filled.
The Downtown Boulder Visitor Center gives a Downtown Dash stamp for attending.
No admission price is listed, so the parade is treated as a free public event.
